description: Use when the user has a mailed loan or credit offer, wants to compare personal loan rates, is deciding whether to respond to a letter, or asks for a personal loan or rate check. Returns a soft-pull rate comparison through an independent marketplace (Upstart). Checking does not affect credit score. LendMail is not a lender; all loans are made by regulated financial institutions on the marketplace.

estimated_amount.description: Optional estimated loan amount in USD.

loan_purpose.description: Optional short description of what the loan is for (debt consolidation, home repair, etc.).

source_lender.description: Optional name of the lender on the original mail piece (e.g. SoFi, Prosper). Helps contextualize the comparison.

name: compare_personal_loans
title: Compare personal loans
